item_name: Rothco Deluxe Air Force Low Profile Cap - Navy Blue
item_short_desc: Show your pride for the United States Air Force with Rothco’s Deluxe Air Force Low Profile Cap, officially licensed by the U.S. Air Force. Made from lightweight brushed cotton twill, this cap offers long-lasting durability and comfort. The front features raised embroidered "Air Force" text, while the left brim displays "U.S. Air Force" text for added style. A sandwich brim with woven "USAF" text enhances the design. The internal sweatband ensures superior comfort, keeping sweat away from your eyes.
